title: Use two layers of Flexbox to arrange the navigation bar
goal: Let the station name and link group occupy one end of the navigation bar, and keep the link group horizontally.
summary: Flexbox only participates in arranging the direct child elements of the container. To individually control the arrangement within a link group, make it a Flexbox container as well.
tasks: Let .site-nav use Flexbox so that the site name and link group are arranged horizontally, on both ends, and vertically centered.
Use Flexbox to arrange the links in .nav-links horizontally, leaving 16px between the two items.
hint: first processes the two direct sub-elements of the navigation bar, and then writes the rules for arranging links to .nav-links.

example.note: The total price is displayed on the left end of the settlement bar, and the payment button group is placed on the right end. Button groups use their own Flexbox to control the spacing between each button.
